args.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation for local MinIO setup
args.body:
File: README.md

Step 2 of "Running locally" suggests MinIO as the quickest option for the S3-compatible store but doesn't mention that `S3_ENDPOINT` (e.g. `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000`) must be set to point uploads at it instead of AWS, and that the target bucket must be created in MinIO first. Add a line to step 2 or 3 covering both, pointing to docs/CONFIG.md for the full setting reference.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The "Running locally" steps mention MinIO as the quickest option for the S3-compatible store but never say to set `S3_ENDPOINT` (so uploads default to AWS) or to create the bucket first. Opened a PR to add a line in step 2/3 covering both, with a pointer to docs/CONFIG.md.
